Beautiful results indeed. 

The Ultimate 08 and the Ultimate 15 emulsions and the special Ultimate developer and bleach for the plates are now available in the United States:

“**Ultimate Holography(tm)**” Plates, Films, and Chemistry for producing holograms of unsurpassed quality are being proudly distributed in the U.S. by **Polaris Research Group**. Ultimate Holography emulsions produce the best holograms in the world. They are absolutely consistent in perfomance. Ultimate Plates meet the requirements for the highest quality holographic work for a wide variety of applications, ranging from high sensitivity for pulsed and continuous lasers to very high resolution for holographic reflection applications.

We offer both **8 nm** and **15 nm** grain size emulsions on glass plates and films in sizes from 2.5 x 2.5 inches up to 24 x 32 inches. Emulsions are available for all wavelengths both with and without pre-shifts. These media are immediately available for ordering (even on-line) to all government, commercial, educational, and private concerns.

PRG Ultimate Holography media is very high resolution for all holographic applications (~10,000 lines/mm with 08 nm emulsion). These media have been developed to completely eliminate washing, sensitizing, latensification, hardening or other laborious pre-treatments often necessary in other currently available materials.

Ultimate Holography processing chemistry has been simplified to two optimized, low toxicity baths, developer and bleach. This chemistry is available in pre-packaged concentrated form. All our materials have been optimized for this safe and easy processing.

Polaris Research Group (PRG) in Cleveland, Ohio has been a leader in offering highly accurate Holographic interferometry services for nondestructive test, evaluation, and analysis to the commercial market since 1995.
